WITH rj_items AS (
  SELECT oi.freight_value,
    o.order_purchase_timestamp,
    CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-08-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-09-01' THEN 'window'
         WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-08-01' THEN 'baseline'
    END AS period
  FROM orders.order_items oi
  JOIN orders.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN orders.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.customer_state = 'RJ'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-07-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-09-01'
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN period = 'window' THEN freight_value END), 4) AS value,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN period = 'baseline' THEN freight_value END), 4) AS baseline,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN period = 'window' THEN freight_value END) - AVG(CASE WHEN period = 'baseline' THEN freight_value END), 4) AS abs_change,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN period = 'window' THEN freight_value END) / NULLIF(AVG(CASE WHEN period = 'baseline' THEN freight_value END), 0) - 1, 4) AS rel_change
FROM rj_items
WHERE period IS NOT NULL;
